profile_text.body:
Read is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA. The company describes itself as an AI copilot that transforms meetings, emails, and messages into summaries, insights, and instant answers across devices. Its core pitch is that it connects to a wide range of tools, including meetings, messages, emails, CRM systems, and documents, in a platform-agnostic way to deliver unified insights.

The company's primary product is Read.ai, categorized as a meeting analytics AI assistant. The site highlights real-time transcription, smart summaries, and AI-powered search and discovery across workplace content. The product also incorporates engagement scoring, wellness insights, and behavioral data, with privacy noted as a relevant consideration for that feature set.

The held facts indicate that Read has 161 points of legal exposure associated with California, though no specific cases are on record in the dataset. The MCP registry entries associated with the Read name cover a broad and largely unrelated set of third-party tools, including database query servers, RSS readers, and zoning intelligence tools, none of which appear to be Read.ai products directly.
